segments.ja264:1.1: Panādo nāma so rājā, yassa yūpo suvaṇṇayo;
segments.ja264:1.3: Tiriyaṃ soḷasubbedho [soḷasapabbedho (sī. pī.)], uddhamāhu [uccamāhu (sī. syā. pī.)] sahassadhā.
segments.ja264:2.1: Sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu [satabhedo (sī. pī.), satabheṇḍu (sī. nissaya)], dhajāsu haritāmayo;
segments.ja264:2.3: Anaccuṃ tattha gandhabbā, cha sahassāni sattadhā.
segments.ja264:3.1: Evametaṃ [evameva (ka.)] tadā āsi, yathā bhāsasi bhaddaji;
segments.ja264:3.3: Sakko ahaṃ tadā āsiṃ, veyyāvaccakaro tavāti.
